name: mf4-rs
description: Ergonomic TypeScript wrapper over the mf4-rs WebAssembly bindings for reading and writing ASAM MDF 4 files.

scripts.build:wasm: cd .. && wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir js/pkg-node -- --features wasm && node -e "fs.rmSync('js/pkg-node/.gitignore',{force:true})"
scripts.build:wasm:web: cd .. && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir js/pkg-web -- --features wasm && node -e "fs.rmSync('js/pkg-web/.gitignore',{force:true})"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:wasm:web && npm run build && npm run build:web && npm test
